description: This file defines the 'Sender' class within the Goteo project's mailing system. It encapsulates functionality for managing email senders, including CRUD operations, status checks, batch sending, and subscriber management, specifically for handling mass email dispatches in the application.

classes.name: Sender
classes.description: A class responsible for managing email sending configurations and operations, including CRUD functions, status checks, batch processing, and subscriber management within the Goteo mailing system.

methods.name: getMail
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the Mail object associated with this sender.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to provide dynamic retrieval of the email subject.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the sender object, primarily checking for the presence of a mail ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts the sender data into the database, validating beforehand.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the sender is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the sender.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Checks if the sender is locked.

methods.name: setLock
methods.description: Sets or unsets the lock status on the sender.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Checks if the email has been marked as sent.

methods.name: setSent
methods.description: Marks the email as sent or unsent.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a secure link for the mailing.

methods.name: getPendingRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recipients pending email delivery, with options for locking and ordering.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves all recipients for the mailing, with count option.

methods.name: getStatusObject
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current sending status metrics.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Simplified status string ('sent', 'sending', 'inactive') based on current metrics.

methods.name: initiateSending
methods.description: Creates a new mailing and batch inserts recipients for mass email dispatch.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a mailing record by ID or last record, with exception handling.

methods.name: getFromMailId
methods.description: Retrieves a mailing record based on associated mail ID.

methods.name: getMailingList
methods.description: Lists mailing records with pagination or count.

methods.name: addSubscribersFromSQL
methods.description: Bulk inserts subscribers from a supplied SQL fragment.

methods.name: addSubscribersFromSQLValues
methods.description: Bulk inserts subscribers using prepared statement values.

methods.name: addSubscribers
methods.description: Adds individual subscriber objects to the mailing.

methods.name: cleanOld
methods.description: Removes outdated or inactive mailing records beyond a specified number of days.
